<h1 id="stream-chat-api">Stream Chat API v79.19.1</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://chat.stream-io-api.com">https://chat.stream-io-api.com</a> - Production

* <a href="http://localhost:3030">http://localhost:3030</a> - Local

<a href="https://getstream.io/chat/docs/">Stream Chat Documentation</a>

# Authentication

* API Key (JWT)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. JWT should be always provided when stream-auth-type=jwt.

Using JWT auth request could be authenticated as user or as server-side.

When using user authentication permission checking is going to be applied to requests based on the user that is
performing a request.

The `authorization` header should be a JWT string signed using the secret attached to the API key used to perform
requests.

**WARNING** all client-side official SDK do not ship with token generation; this is to make sure that the API secret is not
shared with an untrusted party such as a browser or a iOS/Android application. Tokens **must** be generated server-side.
If you wish, you can configure your application to ignore authentication (see `disable_auth_check`)
The JWT string must include only the user_id claim and can include any built-in JWT claim such as iat, exp as well.

* API Key (api_key)
    - Parameter Name: **api_key**, in: query. Application API key should be always set in order to authenticate the request.

* API Key (stream-auth-type)
    - Parameter Name: **Stream-Auth-Type**, in: header. Stream-Auth-Type should be always set in order to authenticate the request. Possible
values: `jwt` or `anonymous`.

`jwt` allows you to authenticate as a user. With this auth type you should also provide valid JWT in Authorization
header.

`anonymous` allows you to authenticate as anonymous user. Please note that most advanced features are not available
to anonymous users.

<h1 id="stream-chat-api-settings">Settings</h1>

## Get App Settings

<a id="opIdGetApp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/app?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}"
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|[GetApplicationResponse](#schemagetapplicationresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

```bash
  -X PATCH \

  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
```

## List block lists

<a id="opIdListBlockLists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/blocklists?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}"
```

|» message_retention|body|string|false|Number of days to keep messages. 'infinite' disables retention|
|» mutes|body|boolean|false|Enables mutes|
|» name|body|string|true|Channel type name|
|» permissions|body|[[PolicyRequest](#schemapolicyrequest)]|false|List of permissions for the channel type|
|» push_notifications|body|boolean|false|Enables push notifications|
|» reactions|body|boolean|false|Enables message reactions|
|» read_events|body|boolean|false|Read events support|
|» replies|body|boolean|false|Enables message replies (threads)|
|» search|body|boolean|false|Enables message search|
|» typing_events|body|boolean|false|Typing events support|
|» uploads|body|boolean|false|Enables file uploads|
|» url_enrichment|body|boolean|false|Enables URL enrichment|

<h3 id="query-campaigns-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|[QueryCampaignsResponse](#schemaquerycampaignsresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

|201|Created|Successful response|[UpdateSegmentResponse](#schemaupdatesegmentresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

<h1 id="stream-chat-api-channels">Channels</h1>

## Query channels

<a id="opIdQueryChannels"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "client_id": "string",
    "connection_id": "string",
    "filter_conditions": {
      "property1": null,
      "property2": null
    },
    "limit": 0,
    "member_limit": 0,
    "message_limit": 0,
    "offset": 0,
    "presence": true,
    "sort": [
      {
        "direction": 0,
        "field": "string"
      }
    ],
    "state": true,
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string",
    "watch": true
  }'
```

<h3 id="query-channels-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|client_id|query|string|false|none|
|connection_id|query|string|false|none|
|body|body|[QueryChannelsRequest](#schemaquerychannelsrequest)|true|Query Channels Request|
|» client_id|body|string|false|none|
|» connection_id|body|string|false|none|
|» filter_conditions|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» limit|body|number|false|Number of channels to limit|
|» member_limit|body|number|false|Number of members to limit|
|» message_limit|body|number|false|Number of messages to limit|
|» offset|body|number|false|Channel pagination offset|
|» presence|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sort|body|[[SortParamRequest](#schemasortparamrequest)]|true|List of sort parameters|
|» state|body|boolean|false|Whether to update channel state or not|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|
|» user_id|body|string|false|none|
|» watch|body|boolean|false|Whether to start watching found channels or not|

<h3 id="query-channels-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Channels list|[ChannelsResponse](#schemachannelsresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Deletes channels asynchronously

<a id="opIdDeleteChannels"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/delete?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "cids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "hard_delete": true
  }'
```

`POST /channels/delete`

Allows to delete several channels at once asynchronously

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "hard_delete": true
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-channels-asynchronously-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[DeleteChannelsRequest](#schemadeletechannelsrequest)|true|none|
|» cids|body|[string]|false|All channels that should be deleted|
|» hard_delete|body|boolean|false|Specify if channels and all ressources should be hard deleted|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "duration": "string",
  "result": {
    "property1": {
      "error": "string",
      "status": "string"
    },
    "property2": {
      "error": "string",
      "status": "string"
    }
  },
  "task_id": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "StatusCode": 0,
  "code": 0,
  "details": [
    0
  ],
  "duration": "string",
  "exception_fields": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "message": "string",
  "more_info": "string"
}
```

> 429 Response

```json
{
  "StatusCode": 0,
  "code": 0,
  "details": [
    0
  ],
  "duration": "string",
  "exception_fields": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "message": "string",
  "more_info": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-channels-asynchronously-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[DeleteChannelsResponse](#schemadeletechannelsresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Mark channels as read

<a id="opIdMarkChannelsRead"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/read?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /channels/read`

Marks channels as read up to the specific message. If no channels is given, mark all channel as read

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "user": {
    "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "banned": true,
    "id": "string",
    "invisible": true,
    "language": "string",
    "push_notifications": {
      "disabled": true,
      "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    },
    "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "role": "string",
    "teams": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "user_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="mark-channels-as-read-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[MarkChannelsReadRequest](#schemamarkchannelsreadrequest)|true|none|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|
|» user_id|body|string|false|none|

<h3 id="mark-channels-as-read-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[MarkReadResponse](#schemamarkreadresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

<h3 id="get-or-create-channel-type-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[ChannelStateResponse](#schemachannelstateresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

<h3 id="update-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateChannelRequest](#schemaupdatechannelrequest)|true|Channel update request|
|» accept_invite|body|boolean|false|Set to `true` to accept the invite|
|» add_members|body|[[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)]|false|List of user IDs to add to the channel|
|» add_moderators|body|[string]|true|List of user IDs to make channel moderators|
|» assign_roles|body|[[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)]|false|List of channel member role assignments. If any specified user is not part of the channel, the request will fail|
|» cooldown|body|number|false|Sets cool down period for the channel in seconds|
|» data|body|[ChannelRequest](#schemachannelrequest)|false|none|
|» demote_moderators|body|[string]|true|List of user IDs to take away moderators status from|
|» hide_history|body|boolean|false|Set to `true` to hide channel's history when adding new members|
|» invites|body|[[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)]|false|List of user IDs to invite to the channel|
|» message|body|[MessageRequest](#schemamessagerequest)|false|Message to send to the chat when channel is successfully updated|
|» reject_invite|body|boolean|false|Set to `true` to reject the invite|
|» remove_members|body|[string]|true|List of user IDs to remove from the channel|
|» skip_push|body|boolean|false|When `message` is set disables all push notifications for it|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|
|» user_id|body|string|false|none|

<h3 id="update-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[UpdateChannelResponse](#schemaupdatechannelresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Delete channel

<a id="opIdDeleteChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/string/string?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}"
```

Deletes channel

|id|path|string|true|none|
|hard_delete|query|boolean|false|none|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|client_id|query|string|false|none|
|connection_id|query|string|false|none|
|body|body|[ChannelGetOrCreateRequest](#schemachannelgetorcreaterequest)|true|none|
|» client_id|body|string|false|none|
|» connection_id|body|string|false|none|

|» messages|body|[MessagePaginationParamsRequest](#schemamessagepaginationparamsrequest)|false|none|

|» state|body|boolean|false|Refresh channel state|

<h3 id="get-or-create-channel-type-id-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[ChannelStateResponse](#schemachannelstateresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Mark read

<a id="opIdMarkRead"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/string/string/read?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "message_id": "string",
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /channels/{type}/{id}/read`

Marks channel as read up to the specific message

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message_id": "string",
  "user": {
    "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "banned": true,
    "id": "string",
    "invisible": true,
    "language": "string",
    "push_notifications": {
      "disabled": true,
      "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    },
    "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "role": "string",
    "teams": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "user_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="mark-read-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[MarkReadRequest](#schemamarkreadrequest)|true|none|
|» message_id|body|string|false|ID of the message that is considered last read by client|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|
|» user_id|body|string|false|none|

|---|---|---|---|---|

|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

## Show channel

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/string/string/show?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,

        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"

      "role": "string",

        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

<h3 id="truncate-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[TruncateChannelRequest](#schematruncatechannelrequest)|true|none|
|» hard_delete|body|boolean|false|Permanently delete channel data (messages, reactions, etc.)|
|» message|body|[MessageRequest](#schemamessagerequest)|false|Represents any chat message|
|» skip_push|body|boolean|false|When `message` is set disables all push notifications for it|
|» truncated_at|body|string(date-time)|false|Truncate channel data up to `truncated_at`. The system message (if provided) creation time is always greater than `truncated_at`|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|
|» user_id|body|string|false|none|

<h3 id="truncate-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[TruncateChannelResponse](#schematruncatechannelresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Mark unread

<a id="opIdMarkUnread"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/string/string/unread?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "message_id": "string",
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

```json
}
```

<h3 id="mark-unread-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[MarkUnreadRequest](#schemamarkunreadrequest)|true|none|
|» message_id|body|string|true|ID of the message from where the channel is marked unread|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|

<h3 id="mute-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[MuteChannelResponse](#schemamutechannelresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Unmute channel

<a id="opIdUnmuteChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/moderation/unmute/channel?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "channel_cid": "string",
    "channel_cids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "expiration": 0,
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

<h3 id="search-messages-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|[SearchResponse](#schemasearchresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Sync

<a id="opIdSync"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/sync?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "channel_cids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "client_id": "string",
    "connection_id": "string",
    "last_sync_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string",
    "watch": true,
    "with_inaccessible_cids": true
  }'
```

`POST /sync`

Returns all events happened since client disconnect in specified channels

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "channel_cids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "client_id": "string",
  "connection_id": "string",
  "last_sync_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "user": {
    "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "banned": true,
    "id": "string",
    "invisible": true,
    "language": "string",
    "push_notifications": {
      "disabled": true,
      "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    },
    "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "role": "string",
    "teams": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "user_id": "string",
  "watch": true,
  "with_inaccessible_cids": true
}
```

<h3 id="sync-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|with_inaccessible_cids|query|boolean|false|none|
|watch|query|boolean|false|none|
|client_id|query|string|false|none|
|connection_id|query|string|false|none|
|body|body|[SyncRequest](#schemasyncrequest)|true|none|
|» channel_cids|body|[string]|false|List of channel CIDs to sync|
|» client_id|body|string|false|none|
|» connection_id|body|string|false|none|
|» last_sync_at|body|string(date-time)|true|Date from which synchronization should happen|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|
|» user_id|body|string|false|none|
|» watch|body|boolean|false|If set to true this will start watching requested and newly added channels that user has access to. If error occurred with this option enabled and it is not an input error - channels will still be watched.|
|» with_inaccessible_cids|body|boolean|false|If set to true this will add 'inaccessible_cids' to response type|

<h3 id="sync-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[SyncResponse](#schemasyncresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

<h1 id="stream-chat-api-events">Events</h1>

## Send new message

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/string/string/message?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

  -d '{
    "force_moderation": true,
    "is_pending_message": true,
    "message": {
      "attachments": [
        {
          "actions": [
            {
              "name": "string",
              "style": "string",
              "text": "string",
              "type": "string",
              "value": "string"
            }
          ],
          "asset_url": "string",
          "author_icon": "string",
          "author_link": "string",
          "author_name": "string",
          "color": "string",
          "fallback": "string",
          "fields": [
            {
              "short": true,
              "title": "string",
              "value": "string"
            }
          ],
```

<h3 id="send-new-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[SendMessageRequest](#schemasendmessagerequest)|true|Send Message Request|
|» force_moderation|body|boolean|false|Enable moderation on server-side requests|
|» is_pending_message|body|boolean|false|Make the message a pending message. This message will not be viewable to others until it is committed.|
|» message|body|[MessageRequest](#schemamessagerequest)|true|Represents any chat message|
|» pending_message_metadata|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» skip_enrich_url|body|boolean|false|Do not try to enrich the links within message|
|» skip_push|body|boolean|false|Disables all push notifications for this message|

<h3 id="send-new-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[MessageWithPendingMetadataResponse](#schemamessagewithpendingmetadataresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

## Get many messages

<a id="opIdGetManyMessages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/channels/string/string/messages?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /channels/{type}/{id}/messages`

## Partially message update

<a id="opIdUpdateMessagePartial"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/messages/string?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "set": {
      "property1": null,
      "property2": null
    },
    "skip_enrich_url": true,
    "unset": [
      "string"
    ],
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /messages/{id}`

Updates certain fields of the message

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "set": {
    "property1": null,
    "property2": null
  },
  "skip_enrich_url": true,
  "unset": [
    "string"
  ],
  "user": {
    "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "banned": true,
    "id": "string",
    "invisible": true,

    "teams": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "user_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="partially-message-update-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Automatically added|
|body|body|[UpdateMessagePartialRequest](#schemaupdatemessagepartialrequest)|true|none|
|» set|body|object|true|Sets new field values|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» skip_enrich_url|body|boolean|false|Do not try to enrich the links within message|
|» unset|body|[string]|true|Array of field names to unset|
|» user|body|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|Represents chat user|
|» user_id|body|string|false|none|

<h3 id="partially-message-update-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|[MessageResponse](#schemamessageresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|[APIError](#schemaapierror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The number of allowed requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of remaining requests in the current period|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Timestamp when number of requests will be reset|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
JWT & api_key & stream-auth-type, api_key & stream-auth-type
</aside>

<h3 id="update-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Automatically added|
|body|body|[UpdateMessageRequest](#schemaupdatemessagerequest)|true|Update Message Request|
|» message|body|[MessageRequest](#schemamessagerequest)|true|Represents any chat message|
|» pending_message_metadata|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» skip_enrich_url|body|boolean|false|Do not try to enrich the links within message|

## Run message command action

```bash
curl "https://example.com/messages/string/action?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "ID": "string",
    "form_data": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",

        "disabled": true,

      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

```bash
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \

      "message_id": "string",
      "score": 0,
      "type": "string",

        "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "banned": true,
        "id": "string",
        "invisible": true,

          "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"

        "role": "string",
        "teams": [
          "string"
        ]
      },

    },
    "skip_push": true
  }'
```

## Translate message

<a id="opIdTranslateMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/messages/string/translate?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "language": "af"
  }'
```

`POST /messages/{id}/translate`

Translates message to a given language using automated translation software

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "language": "af"
}
```

<h3 id="translate-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|» language|body|string|true|Language to translate message to|

## Delete Users

<a id="opIdDeleteUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/users/delete?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "conversations": "soft",
    "messages": "soft",
    "new_channel_owner_id": "string",
    "user": "soft",
    "user_ids": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /users/delete`

Deletes users and optionally all their belongings asynchronously.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "conversations": "soft",
  "messages": "soft",
  "new_channel_owner_id": "string",
  "user": "soft",
  "user_ids": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="delete-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[DeleteUsersRequest](#schemadeleteusersrequest)|true|none|
|» conversations|body|string|false|Conversation channels delete mode.<br>Conversation channel is any channel which only has two members one of which is the user being deleted.<br><br>* null or empty string - doesn't delete any conversation channels<br>* soft - marks all conversation channels as deleted (same effect as Delete Channels with 'hard' option disabled)<br>* hard - deletes channel and all its data completely including messages (same effect as Delete Channels with 'hard' option enabled)<br>|
|» messages|body|string|false|Message delete mode.<br><br>* null or empty string - doesn't delete user messages<br>* soft - marks all user messages as deleted without removing any related message data<br>* pruning - marks all user messages as deleted, nullifies message information and removes some message data such as reactions and flags<br>* hard - deletes messages completely with all related information<br>|
|» new_channel_owner_id|body|string|false|none|
|» user|body|string|false|User delete mode.<br><br>* soft - marks user as deleted and retains all user data<br>* pruning - marks user as deleted and nullifies user information<br>* hard - deletes user completely. Requires 'hard' option for messages and conversations as well<br>|
|» user_ids|body|[string]|true|IDs of users to delete|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» conversations|soft|
|» conversations|hard|
|» messages|soft|
|» messages|pruning|
|» messages|hard|
|» user|soft|
|» user|pruning|
|» user|hard|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "duration": "string",
  "task_id": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
  "StatusCode": 0,
  "code": 0,
  "details": [
    0
  ],
  "duration": "string",
  "exception_fields": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "message": "string",
  "more_info": "string"
}
```

> 429 Response

```json
{
  "StatusCode": 0,
  "code": 0,
  "details": [
    0
  ],
  "duration": "string",
  "exception_fields": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "message": "string",
  "more_info": "string"
}
```

## Reactivate user

<a id="opIdReactivateUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/users/string/reactivate?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "created_by_id": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "restore_messages": true,
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /users/{user_id}/reactivate`

Activates user who's been deactivated previously

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "created_by_id": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "restore_messages": true,
  "user_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="reactivate-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[ReactivateUserRequest](#schemareactivateuserrequest)|true|none|
|» created_by_id|body|string|false|ID of the user who's reactivating the user|
|» name|body|string|false|Set this field to put new name for the user|
|» restore_messages|body|boolean|false|Restore previously deleted messages|
|» user_id|body|string|true|none|

## Create device

<a id="opIdCreateDevice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl "https://example.com/devices?api_key=${API_KEY}" \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Stream-Auth-Type: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "id": "string",
    "push_provider": "firebase",
    "push_provider_name": "string",
    "user": {
      "ban_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "banned": true,
      "id": "string",
      "invisible": true,
      "language": "string",
      "push_notifications": {
        "disabled": true,
        "disabled_until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      },
      "revoke_tokens_issued_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "role": "string",
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "user_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /devices`

Adds a new device to a user, if the same device already exists the call will have no effect

`POST /moderation/unflag`

Removes previously created user or message flag

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target_message_id": "string",
  "target_user_id": "string",
  "user": {
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|auto_translation_enabled|boolean|false|none|Whether auto translation is enabled or not|
|auto_translation_language|string|false|none|Language to translate to when auto translation is active|
|cid|string|true|none|Channel CID (<type>:<id>)|
|config|[ChannelConfigWithInfo](#schemachannelconfigwithinfo)|false|none|Channel configuration|
|cooldown|number|false|none|Cooldown period after sending each message|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of creation|
|created_by|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|Creator of the channel|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of deletion|
|disabled|boolean|true|none|none|
|frozen|boolean|true|none|Whether channel is frozen or not|
|hidden|boolean|false|none|Whether this channel is hidden by current user or not|
|hide_messages_before|string(date-time)|false|none|Date since when the message history is accessible|
|id|string|true|none|Channel unique ID|
|last_message_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the last message sent|
|member_count|number|false|none|Number of members in the channel|
|members|[[ChannelMember](#schemachannelmember)]|false|none|List of channel members (max 100)|
|mute_expires_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of mute expiration|
|muted|boolean|false|none|Whether this channel is muted or not|
|own_capabilities|[string]|false|none|List of channel capabilities of authenticated user|
|team|string|false|none|Team the channel belongs to (multi-tenant only)|
|truncated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the latest truncation of the channel|
|truncated_by|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|type|string|true|none|Type of the channel|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of the last update|

|auto_translation_language|string|false|none|Language to translate to when auto translation is active|
|cid|string|false|none|Channel CID (<type>:<id>)|
|config|[ChannelConfigWithInfoRequest](#schemachannelconfigwithinforequest)|false|none|Channel configuration|
|cooldown|number|false|none|Cooldown period after sending each message|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of creation|
|created_by|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Creator of the channel|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of deletion|
|disabled|boolean|false|none|none|
|frozen|boolean|false|none|Whether channel is frozen or not|
|hidden|boolean|false|none|Whether this channel is hidden by current user or not|
|hide_messages_before|string(date-time)|false|none|Date since when the message history is accessible|
|id|string|false|none|Channel unique ID|
|last_message_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the last message sent|
|member_count|number|false|none|Number of members in the channel|
|members|[[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)]|false|none|List of channel members (max 100)|
|mute_expires_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of mute expiration|
|muted|boolean|false|none|Whether this channel is muted or not|
|own_capabilities|[string]|false|none|List of channel capabilities of authenticated user|
|team|string|false|none|Team the channel belongs to (multi-tenant only)|
|truncated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the latest truncation of the channel|
|truncated_by|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|type|string|false|none|Type of the channel|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of the last update|

<h2 id="tocS_DeleteUsersRequest">DeleteUsersRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadeleteusersrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_DeleteUsersRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSdeleteusersrequest"></a>
<a id="tocsdeleteusersrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "conversations": "soft",
  "messages": "soft",
  "new_channel_owner_id": "string",
  "user": "soft",
  "user_ids": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|conversations|string|false|none|Conversation channels delete mode.<br>Conversation channel is any channel which only has two members one of which is the user being deleted.<br><br>* null or empty string - doesn't delete any conversation channels<br>* soft - marks all conversation channels as deleted (same effect as Delete Channels with 'hard' option disabled)<br>* hard - deletes channel and all its data completely including messages (same effect as Delete Channels with 'hard' option enabled)<br>|
|messages|string|false|none|Message delete mode.<br><br>* null or empty string - doesn't delete user messages<br>* soft - marks all user messages as deleted without removing any related message data<br>* pruning - marks all user messages as deleted, nullifies message information and removes some message data such as reactions and flags<br>* hard - deletes messages completely with all related information<br>|
|new_channel_owner_id|string|false|none|none|
|user|string|false|none|User delete mode.<br><br>* soft - marks user as deleted and retains all user data<br>* pruning - marks user as deleted and nullifies user information<br>* hard - deletes user completely. Requires 'hard' option for messages and conversations as well<br>|
|user_ids|[string]|true|none|IDs of users to delete|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|conversations|soft|
|conversations|hard|
|messages|soft|
|messages|pruning|
|messages|hard|
|user|soft|
|user|pruning|
|user|hard|


Represents an BaseEvent that happened in Stream Chat

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|automoderation|boolean|false|none|Only applicable to `message.flagged` BaseEvent.|
|automoderation_scores|[ModerationResponse](#schemamoderationresponse)|false|none|Only applicable to `message.flagged` BaseEvent.|
|channel|[ChannelResponse](#schemachannelresponse)|false|none|Represents channel in chat|
|channel_id|string|false|none|none|
|channel_type|string|false|none|none|
|cid|string|false|none|Channel CID (<type>:<id>)|
|connection_id|string|false|none|Only applicable to `health.check` BaseEvent|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Date/time of creation|
|created_by|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|User who issued moderation action. Only applicable to moderation-related events|
|me|[OwnUser](#schemaownuser)|false|none|none|
|member|[ChannelMember](#schemachannelmember)|false|none|none|
|message|[Message](#schemamessage)|false|none|Represents any chat message|
|parent_id|string|false|none|ID of thread. Used in typing events|
|reaction|[Reaction](#schemareaction)|false|none|Represents user reaction to a message|
|reason|string|false|none|Ban reason. Only applicable to `user.banned` BaseEvent|
|team|string|false|none|none|
|type|string|true|none|Event type. To use custom BaseEvent types see Custom Events documentation|
|user|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|user_id|string|false|none|none|
|watcher_count|number|false|none|Number of watchers who received this BaseEvent|


Represents an BaseEvent that happened in Stream Chat

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|automoderation|boolean|false|none|Only applicable to `message.flagged` BaseEvent.|
|automoderation_scores|[ModerationResponseRequest](#schemamoderationresponserequest)|false|none|Only applicable to `message.flagged` BaseEvent.|
|channel|[ChannelResponseRequest](#schemachannelresponserequest)|false|none|Represents channel in chat|
|channel_id|string|false|none|none|
|channel_type|string|false|none|none|
|cid|string|false|none|Channel CID (<type>:<id>)|
|connection_id|string|false|none|Only applicable to `health.check` BaseEvent|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of creation|
|created_by|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|User who issued moderation action. Only applicable to moderation-related events|
|me|[OwnUserRequest](#schemaownuserrequest)|false|none|none|
|member|[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)|false|none|none|
|message|[MessageRequest_1](#schemamessagerequest_1)|false|none|Represents any chat message|
|parent_id|string|false|none|ID of thread. Used in typing events|
|reaction|[ReactionRequest](#schemareactionrequest)|false|none|Represents user reaction to a message|
|reason|string|false|none|Ban reason. Only applicable to `user.banned` BaseEvent|
|team|string|false|none|none|
|type|string|true|none|Event type. To use custom BaseEvent types see Custom Events documentation|
|user|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|user_id|string|false|none|none|
|watcher_count|number|false|none|Number of watchers who received this BaseEvent|

Contains information about flagged user or message

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|approved_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the approval|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Date/time of creation|
|created_by_automod|boolean|true|none|none|
|details|[FlagDetails](#schemaflagdetails)|false|none|none|
|rejected_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the rejection|
|reviewed_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the review|
|target_message|[Message](#schemamessage)|false|none|Represents any chat message|
|target_message_id|string|false|none|ID of flagged message|
|target_user|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|Flagged user|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Date/time of the last update|
|user|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|User who flagged a message or a user|

Represents any chat message

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attachments|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|true|none|Array of message attachments|
|before_message_send_failed|boolean|false|none|Whether `before_message_send webhook` failed or not. Field is only accessible in push webhook|
|cid|string|true|none|Channel unique identifier in <type>:<id> format|
|command|string|false|none|Contains provided slash command|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Date/time of creation|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of deletion|
|html|string|true|none|Contains HTML markup of the message. Can only be set when using server-side API|
|i18n|object|false|none|Object with translations. Key `language` contains the original language key. Other keys contain translations|
|id|string|true|none|Message ID is unique string identifier of the message|
|image_labels|object|false|none|Contains image moderation information|
|latest_reactions|[[Reaction](#schemareaction)]|true|none|List of 10 latest reactions to this message|
|mentioned_users|[[UserObject](#schemauserobject)]|true|none|List of mentioned users|
|mml|string|false|none|Should be empty if `text` is provided. Can only be set when using server-side API|
|own_reactions|[[Reaction](#schemareaction)]|true|none|List of 10 latest reactions of authenticated user to this message|
|parent_id|string|false|none|ID of parent message (thread)|
|pin_expires|string(date-time)|false|none|Date when pinned message expires|
|pinned|boolean|true|none|Whether message is pinned or not|
|pinned_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date when message got pinned|
|pinned_by|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|Contains user who pinned the message|
|quoted_message|[Message](#schemamessage)|false|none|Contains quoted message|
|quoted_message_id|string|false|none|none|
|reaction_counts|object|true|none|An object containing number of reactions of each type. Key: reaction type (string), value: number of reactions (int)|
|reaction_scores|object|true|none|An object containing scores of reactions of each type. Key: reaction type (string), value: total score of reactions (int)|
|reply_count|number|true|none|Number of replies to this message|
|shadowed|boolean|true|none|Whether the message was shadowed or not|
|show_in_channel|boolean|false|none|Whether thread reply should be shown in the channel as well|
|silent|boolean|true|none|Whether message is silent or not|
|text|string|true|none|Text of the message. Should be empty if `mml` is provided|
|thread_participants|[[UserObject](#schemauserobject)]|false|none|List of users who participate in thread|
|type|string|true|none|Contains type of the message|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Date/time of the last update|
|user|[UserObject](#schemauserobject)|false|none|Sender of the message. Required when using server-side API|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|regular|
|type|ephemeral|
|type|error|
|type|reply|
|type|system|
|type|deleted|

Represents any chat message

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attachments|[[AttachmentRequest](#schemaattachmentrequest)]|true|none|Array of message attachments|
|cid|[number]|false|none|Channel unique identifier in <type>:<id> format|
|html|string|false|none|Contains HTML markup of the message. Can only be set when using server-side API|
|id|string|false|none|Message ID is unique string identifier of the message|
|mentioned_users|[string]|false|none|List of mentioned users|
|mml|string|false|none|Should be empty if `text` is provided. Can only be set when using server-side API|
|parent|[number]|false|none|none|
|parent_id|string|false|none|ID of parent message (thread)|
|pin_expires|string(date-time)|false|none|Date when pinned message expires|
|pinned|boolean|false|none|Whether message is pinned or not|
|pinned_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Date when message got pinned|
|pinned_by|[number]|false|none|Contains user who pinned the message|
|quoted_message_id|string|false|none|none|
|reaction_scores|[number]|false|none|An object containing scores of reactions of each type. Key: reaction type (string), value: total score of reactions (int)|
|show_in_channel|boolean|false|none|Whether thread reply should be shown in the channel as well|
|silent|boolean|false|none|Whether message is silent or not|
|text|string|false|none|Text of the message. Should be empty if `mml` is provided|
|user|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Sender of the message. Required when using server-side API|
|user_id|string|false|none|none|

Represents any chat message

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attachments|[[AttachmentRequest](#schemaattachmentrequest)]|false|none|Array of message attachments|
|before_message_send_failed|boolean|false|none|Whether `before_message_send webhook` failed or not. Field is only accessible in push webhook|
|cid|string|false|none|Channel unique identifier in <type>:<id> format|
|command|string|false|none|Contains provided slash command|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of creation|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of deletion|
|html|string|false|none|Contains HTML markup of the message. Can only be set when using server-side API|
|i18n|object|false|none|Object with translations. Key `language` contains the original language key. Other keys contain translations|
|id|string|false|none|Message ID is unique string identifier of the message|
|image_labels|object|false|none|Contains image moderation information|
|latest_reactions|[[ReactionRequest](#schemareactionrequest)]|false|none|List of 10 latest reactions to this message|
|mentioned_users|[[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)]|false|none|List of mentioned users|
|mml|string|true|none|Should be empty if `text` is provided. Can only be set when using server-side API|
|own_reactions|[[ReactionRequest](#schemareactionrequest)]|false|none|List of 10 latest reactions of authenticated user to this message|
|parent_id|string|false|none|ID of parent message (thread)|
|pin_expires|string(date-time)|false|none|Date when pinned message expires|
|pinned|boolean|false|none|Whether message is pinned or not|
|pinned_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date when message got pinned|
|pinned_by|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Contains user who pinned the message|
|quoted_message|[MessageRequest_1](#schemamessagerequest_1)|false|none|Contains quoted message|
|quoted_message_id|string|false|none|none|
|reaction_counts|object|false|none|An object containing number of reactions of each type. Key: reaction type (string), value: number of reactions (int)|
|reaction_scores|object|false|none|An object containing scores of reactions of each type. Key: reaction type (string), value: total score of reactions (int)|
|reply_count|number|false|none|Number of replies to this message|
|shadowed|boolean|false|none|Whether the message was shadowed or not|
|show_in_channel|boolean|false|none|Whether thread reply should be shown in the channel as well|
|silent|boolean|false|none|Whether message is silent or not|
|text|string|true|none|Text of the message. Should be empty if `mml` is provided|
|thread_participants|[[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)]|false|none|List of users who participate in thread|
|type|string|false|none|Contains type of the message|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Date/time of the last update|
|user|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Sender of the message. Required when using server-side API|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|regular|
|type|ephemeral|
|type|error|
|type|reply|
|type|system|
|type|deleted|

Represents user reaction to a message

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message_id|string|false|none|ID of a message user reacted to|
|score|number|false|none|Reaction score. If not specified reaction has score of 1|
|type|string|true|none|The type of reaction (e.g. 'like', 'laugh', 'wow')|
|user|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|user_id|string|false|none|ID of a user who reacted to a message|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|duration|string|true|none|none|
|next|string|false|none|Value to pass to the next search query in order to paginate|
|previous|string|false|none|Value that points to the previous page. Pass as the next value in a search query to paginate backwards|
|results|[[SearchResult](#schemasearchresult)]|true|none|Search results|
|results_warning|[SearchWarning](#schemasearchwarning)|false|none|Warning about the search results|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|force_moderation|boolean|false|none|Enable moderation on server-side requests|
|is_pending_message|boolean|false|none|Make the message a pending message. This message will not be viewable to others until it is committed.|
|message|[MessageRequest](#schemamessagerequest)|true|none|Represents any chat message|
|pending_message_metadata|object|false|none|none|
|skip_enrich_url|boolean|false|none|Do not try to enrich the links within message|
|skip_push|boolean|false|none|Disables all push notifications for this message|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_cids|[string]|false|none|List of channel CIDs to sync|
|client_id|string|false|none|none|
|connection_id|string|false|none|none|

|user|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|user_id|string|false|none|none|
|watch|boolean|false|none|If set to true this will start watching requested and newly added channels that user has access to. If error occurred with this option enabled and it is not an input error - channels will still be watched.|
|with_inaccessible_cids|boolean|false|none|If set to true this will add 'inaccessible_cids' to response type|

|message|[MessageRequest](#schemamessagerequest)|false|none|Represents any chat message|
|skip_push|boolean|false|none|When `message` is set disables all push notifications for it|
|truncated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Truncate channel data up to `truncated_at`. The system message (if provided) creation time is always greater than `truncated_at`|
|user|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|user_id|string|false|none|none|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accept_invite|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` to accept the invite|
|add_members|[[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)]|false|none|List of user IDs to add to the channel|
|add_moderators|[string]|true|none|List of user IDs to make channel moderators|
|assign_roles|[[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)]|false|none|List of channel member role assignments. If any specified user is not part of the channel, the request will fail|
|cooldown|number|false|none|Sets cool down period for the channel in seconds|
|data|[ChannelRequest](#schemachannelrequest)|false|none|none|
|demote_moderators|[string]|true|none|List of user IDs to take away moderators status from|
|hide_history|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` to hide channel's history when adding new members|
|invites|[[ChannelMemberRequest](#schemachannelmemberrequest)]|false|none|List of user IDs to invite to the channel|
|message|[MessageRequest](#schemamessagerequest)|false|none|Message to send to the chat when channel is successfully updated|
|reject_invite|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` to reject the invite|
|remove_members|[string]|true|none|List of user IDs to remove from the channel|
|skip_push|boolean|false|none|When `message` is set disables all push notifications for it|
|user|[UserObjectRequest](#schemauserobjectrequest)|false|none|Represents chat user|
|user_id|string|false|none|none|
